content.rendered:
Early in the Tunnel of Love Express Tour, Bruce was in a Van Morrison state of mind. Although they never made the setlist, he often soundchecked Morrison’s songs. On one night, in fact, he soundchecked three in a row: “Brown-Eyed Girl,” “Tupelo Honey,” and “Crazy Love.”

We don’t have a recording from that night, but we do have one from a few weeks later. Listen in on Bruce’s soundcheck at The Omni in Atlanta, on March 23, 1988. On this night, Bruce mashes up “Crazy Love” with “Tupelo Honey,” and although the sound is distant, it’s simply beautiful.

“Crazy Love” would have made a beautiful addition (with or without “Tupelo Honey”) to the Tunnel of Love setlist. Originally released as a B-side, Morrison’s short, sweet 1970 song has become an enduring and frequently covered standard.

Crazy Love
Never performed live
First soundchecked: March 4, 1988 (Chapel Hill, NC)
Last soundchecked: April 4, 1988 (Largo, MD)

© June 27, 2019

excerpt.rendered: Listen in on a 1988 soundcheck, where Bruce mashes up two Van Morrison classics.

jetpack-related-posts.title: Tupelo Honey
jetpack-related-posts.author: Ken
jetpack-related-posts.excerpt: During sound checks on the Tunnel of Love Tour, Bruce occasionally covered one of Van Morrison's loveliest songs.

jetpack-related-posts.title: Needles and Pins
jetpack-related-posts.author: Ken
jetpack-related-posts.excerpt: Never performed but occasionally soundchecked, Bruce was clearly taken with The Searchers’ “Needles and Pins” during the Born to Run tour.

jetpack-related-posts.title: I’m So Lonesome I Could Cry
jetpack-related-posts.author: Ken
jetpack-related-posts.excerpt: Never "officially" covered in concert, Bruce soundchecked Hank Williams' classic during the Tunnel of Love Tour. Take a listen inside.

jetpack-related-posts.title: Brown Eyed Girl
jetpack-related-posts.author: Ken
jetpack-related-posts.excerpt: Bruce doesn't play "Brown Eyed Girl" often, but when he does, it's a singalong highlight, with no teleprompter required.

jetpack-related-posts.title: Where the Band Was: Oakland, October 26, 2007
jetpack-related-posts.author: Ken
jetpack-related-posts.excerpt: Oakland '07 was a solid early-tour outing with a fantastic main set (if a lackluster encore)--and it was my last show with Danny Federici.

jetpack-related-posts.title: Roll of the Dice: Drive All Night
jetpack-related-posts.author: Ken
jetpack-related-posts.excerpt: You can find the heart of many Springsteen songs in a single line. In "Drive All Night," it's in the sax solo--it says more than any lyric ever could.
